info.title: Sumidoku API
info.description: REST API under /api/v1. Browser requests use the sumidoku.session login cookie; CLI and other non-browser clients may use Authorization: Bearer <token>. With authentication disabled, requests act as the built-in admin. The server has one built-in admin identity and no additional accounts or roles. Errors use {error:{code,message}}. Source capabilities that are not implemented use 501 with code unsupported; dynamic filters, listings, home and deep-link endpoints follow the same convention. Selected source calls accept Accept: application/x-ndjson and then return newline-delimited JSON events instead of the buffered JSON body.

get.summary: Stream download and library update events over SSE
get.description: The stream replays retained events newer than Last-Event-ID, then sends a current snapshot, then live events. The in-memory ring retains the latest 1024 events; ring overflow or a process restart makes the snapshot authoritative. A cursor beyond the current maximum id is reset to the snapshot. Event ids are monotonically increasing and duplicate ids are suppressed. Snapshot query failures close the stream so the client can reconnect and resynchronize. A heartbeat comment is sent every 15 seconds.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Replay retained events with ids strictly greater than this value before sending the snapshot.

events.name: download
events.description: Chapter events only; the manager running state is sent as a separate running event.

events.name: updateSummary
events.description: Sent when an update starts and after each job is accounted; running is true.

events.name: updateComplete
events.description: Sent when an update finishes; running is false and pending is zero.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: Session token or UI-managed API key

sessionCookie.name: sumidoku.session
sessionCookie.description: Login-issued session cookie used by browser API requests. CLI and other non-browser clients use bearer authentication instead.

Refresh.name: refresh
Refresh.description: Empty, 1 or true enables refresh; other values are ignored.

Unsupported.description: Source capability unsupported; dynamic filters/listings/home/deep-link use HTTP 501, while notification, basic login and alternate covers use 501

Conflict.description: State conflict, including duplicate, no_update, not_in_library, resync_required, source_disabled or busy

PayloadTooLarge.description: Upload body exceeds the route limit

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The downloaded artifact is not a CBZ archive

Error.description: Error response; source calls can also produce source_error or timeout, and unexpected server failures produce internal

Image.description: Image bytes with a source-dependent content type and private cache control

JsonValue.description: Any JSON value: object, array, string, number, integer, boolean or null.

id.description: sha256 fingerprint of the key; revocation targets this id

createdAt.description: Unix seconds when the key was created

lastUsedAt.description: Unix seconds of the last authenticated use; null when never used.

key.description: Plaintext key, present only in the creation response

username.description: The built-in admin's login username, present only when the request has a valid authenticated identity

SourceConfig.description: Aidoku SourceInfo.Configuration. Unknown manifest keys are preserved.

RegisterInternalRequest.description: Internal (built-in) source registration, dispatched on type.

paths.description: Root directories of the instance; each must exist and be a directory.

oneshotsDir.description: Directory-name marker enabling the oneshots rule for this instance; absent falls back to the server config.

ids.description: Source keys, exactly the current pinned set.

SettingsValues.description: Flat map of keys to untyped bare JSON values, including integers, booleans, arrays and null.

SettingValue.description: Aidoku externally tagged setting value. Button is a string; other kinds are one-key objects with snake_case fields. Unknown static setting kinds remain strings.

SourceFilter.description: Flat normalized filter. Common fields are always present; variant fields use snake_case and appear only for their filter kind.

type.description: Known values are text, sort, check, select, multi-select, note and range; unknown static types are passed through.

FilterValue.description: Externally tagged Aidoku filter value; each object has exactly one variant key.

MangaInput.description: Source manga supplied by a client. Optional fields may be omitted or null; responses use SourceManga, where serialized optional fields are present.

id.description: Present only when already registered locally.

trashed.description: Local source only: the manga vanished from disk and sits in the trash bin until restored or purged
Local source only: the chapter entry vanished from disk and sits in the trash bin

degraded.description: Present for the OPDS traversal fallback.

NdjsonStream.description: Newline-delimited JSON objects. Events are endpoint-specific manga/layout/component/source/sourceError records, followed by {type:final,payload:<buffered response>} or {type:error,error:{code,message}}. It is a stream, not a JSON array.

ProgressPatch.description: A bare isRead:false without lastPageRead clears the reading trace; supplying lastPageRead refreshes history unless incognito is active.

PageContent.description: Externally tagged page content. x-tuple lists the exact positional schemas for Url and Zip; local-source extensions use Local and OpdsZip strings.

Downloaded.description: Page served from the chapter's finished download product.

height.description: width and height are present together when dimensions are known.

HomeComponentValue.description: Externally tagged Aidoku home component value.

ChapterSort.description: source = the source's listing order, chapter = chapter number (numberless chapters count lowest), date = upload date (missing dates sink to the bottom of the default descending order).

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: includeInUpdate and includeInDownload are rejected; exclusions are stored in library.excluded_update_categories and library.excluded_download_categories.

value.description: Null for flag rules; an integer for valued rules.
Omit or use null for flag rules; valued rules require an integer or numeric string.

downloaded.description: Non-null only for an in-flight download with known progress.

running.description: Present only when type is running.

Settings.description: Flat bare-JSON settings map. Dotted persisted keys remain dotted. Values may be strings, integers, booleans, arrays, objects or null.

library.default_category.description: all, uncategorized, or a positive category id as a string.

local.dirs.description: Legacy: the default local instance's fallback root list. New writes belong in the instance's own source settings.

local.oneshots_dir.description: Legacy: the default local instance's fallback oneshots marker. New writes belong in the instance's own source settings.

includeInUpdate.description: Portable backup-only field; 2 marks update exclusion.

includeInDownload.description: Portable backup-only field; 2 marks automatic-download exclusion.

BackupDoc.description: Portable backup version 1. Import defaults omitted arrays and maps to empty; export includes every field. Source settings can contain credentials.

SyncIdentity.description: Natural-key identity. category_manga identities can additionally carry categoryOrigin, categoryOriginUserId and categoryOriginEntityKey.

entityKey.description: Original origin entity key, not a remapped local id.

modifiedAt.description: Unix milliseconds; equals snapshot.lastModifiedAt for non-deletes and follows it for tombstones.

ServerSettings.description: Structured server settings. Known groups are typed; any additional flat keys are preserved round-trip in additionalProperties. The retired `local` group is rejected on write: local directories are per-source settings now.

lastRun.description: Server-managed backup timestamp; ignored on structured writes.
